name: Justice
description: Uphold fairness, hold wrongdoers accountable, and protect the innocent and vulnerable; the innocent should not be dragged in, even at high cost

name: Freedom
description: The right to personal choice and the autonomy of thought and action, free from coercion by others

name: Life
description: Protect life and oppose killing; the right to life above all

name: Family
description: Family bonds, kinship, and protecting loved ones; family interests come first

name: Faith
description: Religious belief, political ideals, ideology; sacrifice for one's faith

name: Truth / Truth-seeking
description: Pursue objective truth, scientific fact, and historical truth; reject lies and falsehood; truth above all

name: Loyalty
description: Loyalty to organizations, country, employers, and friends; never betray

name: Public Safety
description: Protect the public from danger and maintain social order; collective safety first

name: Environmental Protection
description: Protect nature, reduce pollution, sustainable development; ecology first

name: Contractual Integrity
description: Keep promises and honor agreements; fulfill contractual obligations even at high cost
